purpose: Compact pre-generation memory for character-image work. Read before the first generation/edit attempt in every character-asset session.

when: Before any character-image edit, normalization, retry, or local correction
Before any NEW_IMAGE_REQUIRED character hit/rebound generation or edit
Before retrying a rejected character candidate
Before deriving rebound from an accepted hit
readPolicy.rule: Read IMAGE_EDIT_MASTER_RULE.md first, then use this compact playbook. Read longer registries/specs/task ledgers when the current actionKey needs more detail.

rules: Do not create a fresh character drawing from text alone.
The approved initial neutral/home pose is the mandatory parent reference for every new character variant.
A nearby APPROVED variant may be used only as a secondary reference; it never replaces the neutral parent reference.
If the approved baseline bytes cannot be obtained and identified, do not generate.
Rejected/NEVER_USE candidates may never be used as a parent or style reference.

immutableVisualIdentity: same body scale and approximately 4-head chibi proportion
same face/head silhouette and hair identity
allowedChanges: minimum arm/hand/stick movement needed for the target part
minimum leg/foot movement needed for the target pedal
small torso lean required by believable reach

highRiskFailures.avoid: Do not generate from text-only description; require direct baseline edit.
highRiskFailures.detect: Different face/body/camera or metadata/visual evidence of fresh redraw.
Face/camera turns toward front or side.

highRiskFailures.avoid: Resolve target contact point before generation.
highRiskFailures.detect: Right-side RC/RD appears on left-side cymbal or vice versa.

highRiskFailures.avoid: Character layer must remain person + stool only.
highRiskFailures.detect: Cymbal/drum/pedal/hardware pixels appear in the character PNG.

highRiskFailures.avoid: Keep pelvis/stool/core body anchored to baseline.

highRiskFailures.detect: Whole body scale, viewpoint, crop, or framing changes.

highRiskFailures.avoid: Read authoritative limb sidecar/actionKey before generation.
highRiskFailures.detect: Hand/foot side does not match actionKey.

highRiskFailures.avoid: Derive rebound from accepted hit plus baseline, not as an unrelated redraw.
highRiskFailures.detect: Rebound does not visually connect hit to next/neutral state.

highRiskFailures.avoid: Keep rough black linework; no coloring, shading, gradients, polished anime rendering.
highRiskFailures.detect: Line/finish quality no longer matches approved set.

highRiskFailures.avoid: Check reject registry and SHA/path deny list before use.

firstAttemptChecklist: Resolve current READY actionKey and phase from NEXT_ASSET_QUEUE.json.
Resolve authoritative limb(s) from full-song limb sidecar.
Load/identify approved neutral baseline as parent image.
Resolve instrument contact point and screen side.
Check FAILURE_PATTERN_REGISTRY only for target-relevant failures.
Check nearest APPROVED hit/rebound only as secondary reference.
Generate/edit only after the above are satisfied.
qaLoop: Reject immediately only for unreadable/wrong-size/empty/no-alpha/rejected bytes, obvious wrong limb/action, obvious identity/camera corruption, or obvious hardware/background contamination.
Record diff/contact/edit-metadata/centroid concerns as non-blocking signals.
If lightweight gate passes, formal-save/register the pair and continue to the next READY asset.
Do not micro-tune contact or transition before the contiguous block is assembled.
After all assets for the block are formal, map the block into runtime and capture actual PC/Xperia screenshots.
Use runtime screenshots to judge contact, hit/rebound naturalness, neutral recovery, and registration.
Repair only the specific assets that visibly fail runtime QA; keep all others fixed.
For a true hard failure, classify the failure and invoke tools/character-retry-controller.mjs.
speedRules: Finish the current contiguous block before fine visual tuning.
PRE_RUNTIME visual warnings do not block formal registration unless they reveal a hard failure.
Prefer deterministic local edits and approved-asset reuse over full-frame image generation.
Runtime screenshot evidence is the primary authority for contact/naturalness.
Do not repeat an already-passed image merely to improve synthetic overlay metrics.
Batch up to the whole current measure block when only lightweight gates remain.
successHeuristics: A usable candidate that preserves identity/camera/layer purity should reach runtime quickly.
Fine contact alignment is cheaper and more reliable to judge in the actual app than in isolated synthetic overlays.
Formal registration is not final visual approval; final approval happens after runtime screenshots.
Only visible runtime defects should trigger targeted redraw/edit.

crossTerminalLearning.rule: All terminals/sessions share image-generation lessons through GitHub main. Before any image generation/edit, refresh latest main and read this playbook plus FAILURE_PATTERN_REGISTRY and REJECTED_ASSET_REGISTRY. After any new failure or successful recovery, persist the lesson before the next image attempt.
beforeGeneration: Refresh GitHub main; never rely on a cached ledger from another terminal.
Search action-specific transaction/history for previous attempts, SHAs and rejection reasons.
Do not repeat a strategy already marked failed or hard-stopped.
afterFailure: Record actionKey, phase, attempt, source parent/path/SHA, candidate path/SHA when available, exact visual failure, failure-pattern id, QA evidence and timestamp.
Record what must not be repeated and the next permitted strategy.
Add reusable failure patterns to FAILURE_PATTERN_REGISTRY.json; add specific forbidden bytes/paths to REJECTED_ASSET_REGISTRY.json.
Run character-retry-controller for true hard failures before another retry.
afterSuccess: Record the successful parent, local edit/derivation strategy, QA evidence, formal SHA and runtime screenshot result so other terminals can reuse the proven method.
Do not overwrite historical failure evidence; mark older candidates superseded/rejected instead.
concurrency: Immediately before ledger, manifest, transaction, mapping or formal writes, re-read latest main.
If another terminal has advanced the same action, preserve the newer state and reconcile instead of overwriting it.
GitHub main is the coordination authority; Dropbox is exact-byte storage and recovery support.

masterImageEditRule.note: Read before this playbook for every character-image generation/edit. Preserve task-specific ledgers and workspace constraints unless they conflict with the master rule.

lineStyleNormalization.rule: For line-style-only work, prefer deterministic raster normalization over generative image editing. Preserve geometry and build apparent thickness from repeated fine 1px-equivalent retraces.

videoToChibiReferenceModel.rule: Video controls appearance/multiview geometry; existing DTX data controls motion/contact. AI may assist only under numeric/semantic constraints.
